blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY, Philippines — To help maintain cleanliness in cemeteries during this year’s observance of “Undas,” Iligan City Mayor Frederick Siao had asked cemetery visitors to bring their own trash bags so they can properly dispose of their waste. “It would be better if the public brought their own trash bags when visiting cemeteries so they could properly dispose of their waste,” Siao said. Thousands are expected to troop to cemeteries on Sunday and Monday to visit the grave sites of departed loved ones as Christendom observes All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day.
